Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding information on disciplinary actions taken against school employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to information on disciplinary actions takenagainst school employees; adding a new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that it is in the bestinterests of Washington's children that parents, school districts, andthe public in general have access to information regarding each schoolemployee's prior disciplinary action. The legislature recognizes thatthis information is currently available via public disclosure requestsbut finds that there is a need to make this information more easilyavailable. It is the intent of the legislature to provide parents,school districts, and the public with additional tools to ensure a safelearning environment for Washington's children.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The superintendent of public instruction shall post on its web sitea list of school employees who have had any disciplinary action takenagainst them and the grounds for the disciplinary action. The list p. 1 SB 6218shall be updated annually at a minimum and shall be available to thepublic. For the purposes of this section, disciplinary action includesprivate or public reprimand, suspension, stayed suspension, orrevocation of a license. A disciplinary action shall not be posted onthe web site if an appeal is still pending. A voluntary surrender ofa license or a voluntary termination of employment during aninvestigation or a disciplinary action shall be posted on the web siteas such.
